title: Pantry Low-Stock and Reorder Forecast
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pantry:item
| stats latest(quantity) as on_hand, avg(weekly_use) as usage by item
| eval weeks_left=round(on_hand/usage,1)
| where weeks_left<2
| sort weeks_left
description: Estimates how many weeks of each staple you have left from your usage rate so you reorder before running out.
value: Running out of a staple mid-recipe is a small daily annoyance a usage-based forecast quietly eliminates.
implementation: Track pantry quantities and typical usage in `index=personal`; schedule weekly and flag items about to run out.
visualization: Table of pantry items sorted by weeks of stock remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how long your kitchen staples will last and reminds you to buy more before you run out.
